ui.cli.help:
Master Cleaner v{version} - cross-platform disk cleaner & optimizer (macOS / Windows / Linux)

Usage: mc <command> [options]

Commands:
  scan        Scan for reclaimable items   [--modules a,b] [--include-expert] [--info] [--roots ...] [--min-large 500MB] [--min-age 90] [--deep] [--json] [--save file] [--quiet]
  clean       Clean (default selection)     [--yes] [--dry-run] [--mode quarantine|trash|delete] [--select-all] [--only ids] [--modules a,b]
  run <id>    Run a scheduled task
  schedule    Scheduled tasks               list | add --name X --cron "0 3 * * *" --modules a,b --mode M | remove <id> | enable/disable <id> | install/uninstall <id>
  daemon      Stay resident, clean on schedule
  restore     Restore the safe vault        [record-id]
  vault       Vault management              list | purge [--older-than 30]
  serve       Start the local dashboard     [--port 43110]
  status      Overview (disk / vault / schedules)
  doctor      Environment self-check
  modules     List all modules
  legal       License, attribution and disclaimer

Examples:
  mc scan --json --save report.json
  mc clean --mode trash --yes
  mc schedule add --name "Daily AI cleanup" --cron "0 4 * * *" --modules ai-residue,dev-caches
  mc daemon
  mc legal

phrases.npm/pnpm/pip/cargo/gradle 等包管理缓存，Xcode 产: Package-manager caches (npm/pnpm/pip/cargo/gradle…), Xcode artifacts and project build dirs like node_modules/venv.
phrases.Docker、Podman、Colima、OrbStack、WSL 等容器与虚拟: Disk usage of containers and VMs: Docker, Podman, Colima, OrbStack, WSL and more.
phrases.Docker/Podman/Colima/OrbStack/WSL 的镜像、层、: Images, layers, build caches and VM disks for Docker/Podman/Colima/OrbStack/WSL.

phrases.AI 编程助手（Claude Code / Codex / Cursor …）、: AI coding agents (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor …), local LLMs, AI desktop app caches and in-project AI residue.
phrases.Finder 残留、iOS 备份、本地快照等 macOS 专有内容。: macOS-specific content: Finder leftovers, iOS backups, local snapshots and more.
phrases..DS_Store、设备备份、本地快照与系统索引。: .DS_Store, device backups, local snapshots and system indexes.
phrases.WinSxS、Windows.old、内存转储、休眠/页面文件等大件检测。: Detect big-ticket items: WinSxS, Windows.old, memory dumps, hibernation/page files.
phrases.WinSxS、更新缓存、休眠/页面文件等系统级占用检测与指引。: Detect and guide system-level usage: WinSxS, update cache, hibernation/page files.

phrases.当前平台不支持此模块: This module is not supported on this platform

phrases.仅清理聊天 / 社交 / 协作应用的使用痕迹（缓存、日志、临时文件），不清理登录: Cleans only usage traces of chat / social / collaboration apps (caches, logs, temp files); never login or chat records.
phrases.卸载应用并清除其缓存、偏好设置等残留。: Uninstall apps and clear their caches, preferences and other leftovers.
phrases.聊天 / 社交 / 协作应用的可重建缓存与临时痕迹清理，保留登录与聊天记录。: Clean rebuildable caches and temp traces of chat / social / collaboration apps, keeping login and chat records.

phrases.完整条款见 DISCLAIMER.md 与 LICENSE。: See DISCLAIMER.md and LICENSE for the full terms.

phrases.避免误删历史与模型: to avoid losing history or models
phrases.AI 会话记录、模型权重等「有价值的残留」默认不勾选，仅统计体积，避免误删历史与: AI session records, model weights and other “valuable residue” are not selected by default; only the size is reported, to avoid losing history or models.
phrases.项目构建产物默认不勾选；确认这些项目可重新构建后再清理。: Project build artifacts are not selected by default; confirm the project can be rebuilt before cleaning.
phrases.模型权重体积大，删除后需重新下载；如不再使用可手动勾选（移入回收站）: Model weights are large and must be re-downloaded if removed; select manually (moved to trash) only if unused.
phrases.包含历史对话与项目上下文，删除不可恢复，默认仅统计: Contains chat history and project context; deleting is unrecoverable, report-only by default.
phrases.包含应用数据，删除后应用需重新登录/下载: Contains app data; the app will need to sign in / download again after removal.
